name: Kefalonia in a day
description_md:
Kefalonia in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Kefalonia, GR.

The route covers 12.7 km of walking between stops and features 5 sightseeing stops along the way. The full day lasts about 6.9 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
